title: Drift-Aware Adaptation Gate Simulation

drift_monitoring.primary_trigger: At least two high-drift features excluding step and step_normalized
drift_monitoring.purpose: Detect meaningful distribution change rather than simply detecting passage of time.

adaptation.requirement: Candidate must be evaluated on temporally subsequent data.

deployment_gate.accept: Candidate AP must exceed current production detector.
deployment_gate.reject: Candidate is rejected when forward performance deteriorates.

observed_result.Phase 1: Drift detected; no future adaptation evaluation in this experiment.

decision_logic.final_policy: Drift detection triggers evaluation, not automatic deployment.

observed_decisions.reason: Drift detected, but adaptation candidates performed worse than the static detector on forward validation.

research_conclusion: Temporal drift is substantial in PaySim, but naive and recency-weighted adaptation degraded forward fraud-detection performance. Therefore, adaptation should be conditional and protected by forward-validation gates.
final_test_isolation: The PaySim test set was not used.
